description: This file defines multiple interface classes in the WPEFramework project for system management, discovery, configuration, lifetime management, and metadata. These interfaces are used for controlling and querying specific aspects of the framework or device, such as reboot, discovery, plugin activation, configuration, and status reporting.

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management operations such as reboot, delete, clone, and environment retrieval.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery operations including start discovery and retrieve discovery results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for managing configuration persistence and retrieval for plugins.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for controlling plugin lifecycle states (activate, deactivate, suspend, resume, etc.) and notification of state changes.

classes.name: ILifeTime::INotification
classes.description: Listener interface for receiving notifications about plugin state changes.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for retrieving status, proxy, link, process information, and version details.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboot the device.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Remove contents of a directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Create a clone of a given plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieve the value of a specified environment variable.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Initiate SSDP network discovery with specified TTL.

methods.name: DiscoveryResults
methods.description: Get SSDP network discovery results.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Store the configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration (get)
methods.description: Retrieve configuration value for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (set)
methods.description: Set configuration value for a given callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a sink for lifecycle notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a lifecycle notification sink.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activate a plugin by callsign.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivate a plugin by callsign.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Set a plugin as unavailable.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernate a plugin with optional timeout.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspend a plugin.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resume a suspended plugin.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Get details of currently running proxies.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Get status and configuration details of a plugin.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Get active connection details.

methods.name: ProcessInfo
methods.description: Get framework process information.

methods.name: Subsystems
methods.description: Get details about active subsystems.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Get version and hash information of WPEFramework.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Retrieve callstack information for a thread index.
